headline: Failed to recommend lowering Damren Road speed limit; requested traffic studies at 37 Stark Road and 99 Rockingham Road; police to use radar trailer.
summary: A motion to recommend lowering the Damren Road speed limit failed, 0-6. Members tabled discussion of the Derry rotary and requested traffic studies at 37 Stark Road and near 99 Rockingham Road. The Derry Police Department will put out a radar trailer, and members approved minutes from three earlier meetings.
decisions: Approved, 6-0, the minutes of the October 16, 2025 meeting as written.
Approved, 6-0, the minutes of the March 19, 2026 meeting as amended.
Approved, 4-0 with two abstentions, the minutes of the May 21, 2026 meeting as written.
Failed, 0-6, to recommend that the Town Council decrease the speed limit on Damren Road.
Tabled, 6-0, discussion of the Derry rotary until the next meeting.
Approved, 6-0, a request that Derry Public Works conduct a traffic study at 37 Stark Road.
Approved, 6-0, that the Derry Police Department will put out a radar trailer.
Approved, 6-0, a request that Derry Public Works conduct a traffic study near 99 Rockingham Road in both directions.

decision_evidence.quote: Chief Feole made a motion to approve the October 16, 2025, minutes as written. Seconded by Walter Deyo. MOTION PASSED (6-0).
Ronald Goldthwaite made a motion to approve the March 19, 2026, minutes as amended. Seconded by Jodi Nelson. MOTION PASSED (6-0).
Chief Feole made a motion to approve the May 21, 2026, minutes as written. Seconded by Clint Havens. MOTION PASSED (4-0) with Chief Feole & David Eastman abstaining.
Clint Havens made a motion that the Highway Safety Committee recommend to the Town Council to decrease the speed limit on Damren Road. Seconded by Chief Feole. MOTION FAILED (0-6).
Ronald Goldthwaite made a motion to table discussion of the Derry rotary until the next meeting. Seconded by Clint Havens. MOTION PASSED (6-0).
Chief Feole made a motion to request that Derry Public Works conduct a traffic study at 37 Stark Road. Seconded by Ronald Goldthwaite. MOTION PASSED (6-0).
Chief Feole made a motion that the Derry Police Department will put out the radar trailer. Seconded by Jodi Nelson. MOTION PASSED (6-0).
Chief Feole made a motion to request that Derry Public Works conduct a traffic study near 99 Rockingham Road in both directions. Seconded by Jodi Nelson. MOTION PASSED (6-0).

decision_titles: Approval of March 19, 2026 minutes, as amended
